```artifact
Feature: Self-Test Functionality

  Scenario: Validate O2 Sensor Accuracy
  Given the self-test system is initialized
  When the O2 sensor accuracy test is initiated
  Then the O2 sensor accuracy should be within acceptable range

  Scenario Outline: Validate Blower Response
  Given the self-test system is initialized
  When the blower response test is initiated
  Then the commanded blower speed should match the achieved pressure
  Examples:
    | commanded speed | achieved pressure |
    | 1000 rpm | 1000 rpm |
    | 1500 rpm | 1500 rpm |
    | 2000 rpm | 2000 rpm |
  Scenario Outline: Validate Pinch Valves Pressure Response
  Given the self-test system is initialized
  When the pinch valves pressure response test is initiated
  Then the pinch valves pressure should match the fixed blower speed
  Examples:
    | fixed blower speed | pinch valves pressure |
    | 1000 rpm | 1000 rpm |
    | 1500 rpm | 1500 rpm |
    | 2000 rpm | 2000 rpm |
  Scenario Outline: Validate Audible Alarm Devices
  Given the self-test system is initialized
  When the audible alarm devices test is initiated
  Then the audible alarm devices should produce current when supplied with voltage
  Examples:
    | voltage | current |
    | 5V | 0.5A |
    | 12V | 1.2A |
  Scenario Outline: Validate Visual Alarm Devices
  Given the self-test system is initialized
  When the visual alarm devices test is initiated
  Then the visual alarm devices should be visible and functioning
  Examples:
    | user confirmation |
    | Yes |
    | No |

```
